page.overview:
Who is Sumire Kamado?

Sumire was a very young small child, with messy black hair that is tipped with red and tied back with a pink bow. She had large black eyes that fade to pink with white pupils, a trait common among the Kamado family.

She wore a grid-patterned pale purple kimono with a light pink obi and had no footwear.

Sumire was usually happy and cheerful, always shown smiling, as is typical of a toddler. Being very young, she was frequently curious, as shown when she approached Yoriichi talking with her father and later watched him perform the moves of his Sun Breathing. According to Sumiyoshi, Sumire enjoyed being lifted up and she squealed with joy when Yoriichi picked her up, since Yoriichi was much taller than Sumiyoshi. Despite her usual happy and cheery demeanor, she appeared saddened when Yoriichi left them for the last time.

While Sumiyoshi and Sumire stood outside their home, she noticed Yoriichi Tsugikuni nearby standing under a tree and tugged at her father's clothes to inform him. After a long chat, where Yoriichi told Sumiyoshi about his life and his regrets about Muzan's escape, the moment grew gloomy; Yoriichi became despondent after reminiscing on his tragedies and Sumiyoshi could not find ways to cheer him up. At that moment, Sumire appeared. thumb|205x205px|Yoriichi hugging Sumire. Tugging at the Demon Slayer's haori, she asked him to carry her. Yoriichi obliged at his friend's request, noting she enjoyed it greatly. As Yoriichi lifted her up, she became overjoyed. Her laughter caused him to break down in tears and he hugged the little girl. Though somewhat bewildered, Sumire returned the favor and embraced him. Her mother appeared shortly after and cheered Yoriichi up as well.
